name: Standard (3-player)
description: The default 3-player game (D63): the full Dragon rules of Good Practice, except the King moves one square in any direction, as in the 2-player Standard (decision 0016). Each Coast piece's first way off the Coast is through A5 (coast.3p.exit, built in S68, decision 0019). Experimental until bot self-play shows the seats are balanced.
notes: Played before S71: Coast pieces attacked from the Coast (coast.3p.attackFrom = allowed) and could not be captured there. Kept with a lock so its games and fairness reports (docs/fairness/standard-3p@0.2.0) replay as they were played (decision 0020).
